text:
maria: Heads up — monitoring alert: correctable ECC errors spiked on us-west-2a-rack7. 6 nodes reporting >100 correctables in 5m window.

ops-bot: [ALERT] node-monitor: ECC_CORRECTABLE_RATE_HIGH: rack=us-west-2a-rack7 nodes=[node-3142,node-3143,node-3147,node-3151,node-3154,node-3159] count=6 severity=major

kevin: Seen. Is the scheduler already rescheduling? free capacity in us-west-2 is ~18% right now.

maria: Not yet — metric shows KV cache pressure going up on those nodes. I want to drain the affected nodes before we see crashes. Proposal: soft-drain first so Dedicated jobs pinned to capacity don't get evicted, then full drain if errors continue.

ashley: Important: we have 2 Dedicated customers pinned to that rack (cust-r334, cust-r889). If we move them cross-region we'll hit egress + SLA concerns. CS needs an FYI if we plan any forced eviction.

jordan: Quick route impact: hosted routes r-778 and r-912 hit those nodes for low-cost model tiers. Dedicated routes r-334 pinned.

kevin: My plan: 1) soft-drain nodes with label ecc-drain, 2) provision temporary capacity in eu-west-2 (4x p4d equivalent) as burst capacity, 3) update smart-routing to shift a portion of new requests to eu-west-2 (no forced multi-region move for pinned dedicated).

hw-ops: RMA kicked for node-3142/3143/3147/3151/3154/3159. Parts ETA ~48h. We'll mark nodes as repair-hold in inventory once drained.

maria: Running soft-drain now. Command: ```

infractl drain-node node-3142 --reason \"ECC spike\" --mode soft --label ecc-drain
infractl drain-node node-3143 --reason \"ECC spike\" --mode soft --label ecc-drain
```

ops-bot: note: autoscaler policy in us-west-2 is region-local. Cross-region provisioning requires manual override or policy change.

ashley: Cost check: cross-region + spot vs reserved — short burst on spot in eu-west-2 will keep costs lower but higher latency. We should prioritize moving stateless, non-latency-critical traffic. Can we throttle re-ranks and long-compute requests?

kevin: Yes. Routing config: set new requests 60% us-west, 40% eu-west for non-pinned, and add route tag to deprioritize re-ranking batch jobs. I'll also avoid moving pinned Dedicated.

maria: Soft-drain completed for node-3142/3143/3147. Output: ```
node-3142: cordon succeeded
node-3142: evict started (soft) - migrated 12 pods gracefully
node-3143: cordon succeeded
node-3143: evict started (soft) - migrated 9 pods gracefully
```

jordan: Traffic shift in progress — current split ~65% us-west / 35% eu-west. Initial p95 latency increase ~+120ms for eu-west served requests, p50 stable. No errors in health-checks so far.

ops-bot: incident update: \"degraded capacity — us-west-2 rack7\" severity=major status=mitigated->monitoring assigned=eng-infra owner=maria incident_id=INC-2024-487

hw-ops: Marked the six nodes repair-hold in inventory (ticket HW-12345). RMA numbers updated. ETA parts 48h, ETA tech onsite 72h if needed.

ashley: I'll message CS and Sales about potential Dedicated impact if we need forced migration. Also flag cost increase for finance.

kevin: Action checklist: 1) maria confirm remaining nodes drained (soft) 2) kevin spin up eu-west-2 burst capacity + update routing 3) hw-ops track RMA and update inventory 4) ashley notify CS/sales/finance 5) monitor for 2h and escalate to full drain if correctables keep rising.

maria: Confirmed — remaining 3 nodes soft-drain queued. I'll post status in 15m.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: check-cordoned-nodes in 15m (auto)
